\tablenote{Bank inventory reconstructed from canonical building events only (HOUSE\_BUILT, HOUSE\_SOLD, HOTEL\_BUILT, HOTEL\_SOLD and bank-side returns on bankruptcy); a hotel conversion returns four houses to the bank and appears as an upward step in the grid. Units: houses and hotels are two separate bank counts (initial 32 and 12); turns are global turn indices; seq is the canonical event sequence. The series file (fable/exhibits/house\_stock\_series.csv) has 1,136 rows, one per building event plus an initial and a final row per game, and was checked against the delivered bank state at every one of the 6,989 decision requests (0 mismatches). Nine games reach zero houses. Decisions at zero houses count exposure to the constraint, not denied demand. Minima agree with Astra's per-game event minima and Sol's zero-stock list.}
